name: Paranoia
summary:
Paranoia is an psychological survival horror game designed for both single-player and multiplayer experiences, with a focus on replayability. It is set in an original universe inspired by the Backrooms. Enter the deepest trenches of an alternate universe with entities where nothing is safe. With over 10 levels to explore on release, over 3 game modes, and much more! 

THE BACKROOMS (FREE-TO-TRY)
Explore the vast world of the backrooms, avoid entities, drink almond water and run for your life.
